description: A hybrid bass drum: a recorded kick blended with a sine oscillator, a square-to-sine sub-oscillator under them, and two envelopes shaping pitch and level.

params.text: Sets the decay time of the pitch envelope, from 0.1 to 2.2 seconds; at exactly 1 second the whole pitch envelope is turned upside down.
Sets the level the pitch envelope holds at, from 0.1 to 0.9 of its peak.
Sets the release time of the pitch envelope, from 0.1 to 2.9 seconds.
Nothing in the module reads this switch; the pitch envelope is turned upside down by the pitch DECAY knob reaching exactly 1 second instead.
Sets the decay time of the amplitude envelope, from 0.1 to 2.2 seconds; at exactly 1 second the whole amplitude envelope is turned upside down.
Sets the level the amplitude envelope holds at, from 0.1 to 0.9 of its peak.
Sets the release time of the amplitude envelope, from 0.1 to 2.9 seconds.
Nothing in the module reads this switch; the amplitude envelope is turned upside down by the amplitude DECAY knob reaching exactly 1 second instead.
Crossfades between the sine oscillator and the recorded kick, 0 for all oscillator and 10 for all sample, despite the panel marking the knob 0 to 5.
Multiplies the sample playback rate and both oscillator frequencies together, from 0.2x to 1.8x.
Sets how much of the sub-oscillator is in the output; the knob reaches half of the full mix and the CV input is needed for more.
Crossfades the sub-oscillator between a square wave at one end and a sine at the other.
Chooses how far below the oscillator the sub-oscillator runs: the same frequency, an octave down, or two octaves down.
Chooses which of the two recorded kicks plays; the choice also sets the oscillator frequency, which is twice the chosen sample's nominal 55Hz or 60Hz.

inputs.text: Restarts the sample from its first frame and retriggers both envelopes each time the voltage rises through 0.5V.
Replaces the pitch envelope with the voltage here divided by 5 for as long as a cable is patched, and the pitch DECAY, SUSTAIN and RELEASE knobs then do nothing.
Adds to the pitch envelope's decay time, 10V covering a 0 to 2.2 second span, with the total clamped to it.
Adds to the pitch envelope's sustain level, 10V covering the 0.1 to 0.9 span, with the total clamped to it.
Adds to the pitch envelope's release time, 10V covering the 0.1 to 2.9 second span, with the total clamped to it.
Replaces the amplitude envelope with the voltage here divided by 5 for as long as a cable is patched, and the amplitude DECAY, SUSTAIN and RELEASE knobs then do nothing.
Adds to the amplitude envelope's decay time, 10V covering a 0 to 2.2 second span, with the total clamped to it.
Adds to the amplitude envelope's sustain level, 10V covering the 0.1 to 0.9 span, with the total clamped to it.
Adds to the amplitude envelope's release time, 10V covering the 0.1 to 2.9 second span, with the total clamped to it.
Adds to BLEND, 10V covering its 0 to 10 span, with the total clamped to it.
Adds to TUNE, 10V covering the 0.2 to 1.8 span, with the total clamped to it.
Adds to the sub-oscillator mix, 10V covering the full 0 to 10 span, with the total clamped to it.
Adds to the sub-oscillator wave blend, 10V covering the full square to sine span, with the total clamped to it.

outputs.text: The drum's audio: the blended sample and oscillator with the sub-oscillator mixed in and the amplitude envelope applied, at 5V for a full-scale sample.

notes: both envelopes hold their sustain for a fixed 4400 samples before releasing, so the length of the gate changes nothing.
the panel and the manual each give the two envelopes a DIRECTION switch, and neither switch is read by the module.
